content: Yasuɛ zzat i lwali Pilaṭus
Deɣya ɣar ṣṣbeḥ zic mcawaren imeqqranen n ikehhanen ak-d imɣaren n řgens d imseřmaden n idlisen d marra Jmaɛet Tameqqrant. Nitni carfen Yasuɛ, iwyen t uca sellmen t i Pilaṭus.
Isseqsa i-t Pilaṭus: “Ma Cek d Ajeǧid n Wudayen?” Yarra-dd xas, inna as: “Cek tennid t.”
Tuɣa imeqqranen n ikehhanen ttcetcan zzayes zeg waṭṭas n tmesřayin.
Isseqsa t Pilaṭus ɛawed, inna as: “Ma war dd-tᵉttarid s ca? Xzar, aṭṭas n yinni xak ittcetcan!”
War dd-yarri Yasuɛ s walu, ařami itebhet Pilaṭus.
Yasuɛ d Bar-Abbas
Innum iḍeǧeq i ijj n umeḥbus di kuř řɛid, wenni ixsen nitni.
Tuɣa din ijjen umi qqaren Bar-Abbas, ḥebbsen t ak-d imɣewwɣen, inni inɣin ijjen deg uɣewweɣ.
Isɣuyy řɣaci uca nitni bdan ttᵉttarren zzayes ḥima ad igg am mammec tuɣa innum ittegg i nitni.
Yarra-dd Pilaṭus, inna: “Ma texsem ad awem dd-arxuɣ i Ujeǧid n Wudayen?”
Minzi tuɣa issen belli imeqqranen n ikehhanen aqa sellmen t zi řeḥsed.
Maca imeqqranen n ikehhanen ɛarnen řɣaci, maḥend ad ttaren ad asen dd-iḍřeq i Bar-Abbas.
Pilaṭus inna asen: “Min texsem ad ggeɣ s wenni umi tᵉttřaɣam Ajeǧid n Wudayen?”
Sɣuyyen ɛawed: “Ṣellb i-t!”
Inna asen Pilaṭus: “Man tuɛeffna i igga?” Xenni arnin di tɣuyyit ɛad ktar: “Ṣellb i-t!”
Am tuɣa ixs Pilaṭus ad issarḍa řɣaci, iḍřeq i Bar-Abbas, maca isellem asen Yasuɛ, awarni řami t hettken s urekkuḍ, ḥima ad t ṣellben.
Iɛeskariyyen sseḥqaran Yasuɛ
Gewwden t iɛeskariyyen ɣar daxeř n řemraḥ n Taddart n Ccraɛ, umi qqaren ‘Prituriyum’, uca ssmunen marra řkumpaniyyet n řɛeskar.
Ssyarḍen as ijj n werruḍ d azeggʷaɣ, muden as ijj n ttaj s isennanen uca qqnen as-t,
bdan ttseǧamen xas, qqaren as: “Azul xak, a Ajeǧid n Wudayen!”
Tuɣa ccaten t ɣar uzeǧif s yijj n weɛmud n uɣanim, ssusufen xas uca uḍaren x ifadden nsen, ɛebden t.
Awarni řami t sseḥqaren, kksen as aseřham azeggʷaɣ uca ssyarḍen as arruḍ nnes, xenni ssuffɣen t ḥima ad t ṣellben.
Abrid ɣar ṣṣalib
Ḥṣaren ijjen wenni dd-ikkin ssenni am dd-yusa zeg iyyar, Cimɛun zi Qayrawan, babas n Aliksandir d Rufus, ḥima ad as yarbu ṣṣalib.
Iwyen Yeccu ɣar wemcan umi qqaren ‘Juljuta’, min ixs ad yini ‘Taceqquft’.
Wcin as binu ixeǧḍen s mirru d amarzag, ḥima ad t isuw, maca Netta war ixs ad t isuw.
Umi t ṣellben, bḍan arruḍ nnes, ggin xas akeccuḍ x min ɣa iksi kuř ijj zzaysen.
Tuɣa tasaɛɛet d třata, aqa-tt d tesɛa n ṣṣbeḥ, umi t ṣellben.
Ssibbet n řmewt nnes aqa-tt di tira-ya sennej nnes: ‘Wa d Ajeǧid n Wudayen’.
Ṣellben akides tnayen n ixewwanen, ijjen x ufusi nnes, wenneɣni x uzeřmaḍ nnes.
Ammu i ttwakemmřent Tira Iqeddsen i iqqaren: “Ittwaḥseb ak-d inni war iseggden.”
Inni ssenni dd-ittekken, tuɣa ttceqqafen dayes, tthezzan izeǧifen nsen, nnan: “A Cek wenni i ɣa ihedmen Zzawect Tameqqrant uca ad tt tebnid ɛawed di třata n wussan,
senjem Ixef nnec, hwa-dd zi ṣṣalib!”
Ammu i t sseḥqaren ɛawed imeqqranen n ikehhanen ak-d imseřmaden n idlisen, nnan: “Tuɣa issenjem inneɣni, maca war izemmar ad issenjem Ixef nnes.
Ejj Lmasiḥ, Ajeǧid n Israil, ad dd-ihwa řexxu zi ṣṣalib, ḥima ad nẓar uca ad dayes namen.” Uřa d yinni ittwaṣellben akides, kkwaren t.
Řmewt n Yasuɛ
Umi dd-tiweḍ tsaɛɛet setta, aqa-tt d ḍḍhur, tewḍa-dd taǧest x temmurt marra ař tesɛa, aqa-tt d třata n uɛecci.
Di tsaɛɛet tesɛa isɣuy Yasuɛ s tmijja tejhed, inna: “Il, Il, lmana cabaqtani?”, min ixs ad yini: “A AREBBI inu, a AREBBI inu, mayemmi dayi tsemḥed?”
Ca zeg inni din ibedden, umi sřin aya, nnan: “Aqa Netta iřaɣa i Iliya!”
Yuzzeř-dd ɣares ijjen, issuff ict n spunxa s řxeǧ, igga i-tt x uɣanim, iwca as ḥima ad isuw. Maca nitni nnan: “Raja! Ejj aneɣ ad nẓar ma ad dd-yas Iliya ḥima ad t-i-dd-issehwa.”
Xenni isɣuy Yasuɛ s ict n tmijja tejhed uca isellem arruḥ nnes.
Ařeḥḥaf n wadaf ɣar Zzawect Tameqqrant ittwacarreg x tnayen zi sennej ɣar swadday.
Umi iẓra řqebṭan n mya i din ibedden zzates, isɣuyyu ammu s jjehd uca xenni ibedd usuffeɣ n nnefs, inna: “S tidett tuɣa Bnadem-a d Mmis n AREBBI!”
Tuɣa din ɛawed timɣarin xezzarent i-dd zi řaggʷaj, jar asent ɛawed Maryam n Majdala d Maryam, yemmas n Yaɛqub, amaẓuẓ, u n Yusis, d Salumi.
tinni t-i-dd-iḍfaren, sexxarent xas umi t tuɣa di Ljalil. Tuɣa din uřa d aṭṭas n timɣarin nneɣnit tinni tuɣa akides i dd-igeɛɛden ɣar Urcalim.
Anḍeř n Yasuɛ
Řami dd-tiweḍ tmeddit n Usewjed, tameddit nni iǧan qbeř i ssebt,
yusa-dd Yusuf zi Ramta, ijj n umcawar icennɛen n Jmaɛet Tameqqrant, wenni tuɣa ittrajan Tageldit n AREBBI. Uca netta izɛem ad yadef ɣar Pilaṭus maḥend ad as ittar arrimet n Yasuɛ.
Itebhet Pilaṭus umi immut ammu deɣya. Iřaɣa-dd i řqebṭan n mya, isseqsa t, ma immut qbeř řweqt.
Umi ifhem man aya zi řqebṭan n mya, iwca arrimet i Yusuf.
Isɣa Yusuf řecfen n řeqṭen azdad, iksi t zi ṣṣalib, icfen i-t di řecfen nni, issars i-t deg wenḍeř i xebcen di sseǧaḥ uca isseqnunni ict n teṣḍart x tewwart n wenḍeř.
Tuɣa Maryam n Majdala d Maryam, yemmas n Yusi, ẓrint mani t ssarsen.

footnotes.text: Il, Il, lmana cabaqtani- tuɣa Yasuɛ issawař s yiřes n Třamit am t ssawařen marra Wudayen di Urcalim d temmurt n Ljalil.
